subject: SableMetrics onboarding: procurement docs, DPA, SOC2, subprocessor list
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@sablemetrics.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@sablemetrics.com
Date: 2028-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SableMetrics onboarding — initial docs and PO path

Hi Priyom / Ben,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. Per our conversation, attaching our standard DPA and a CSV export of our subprocessor inventory so you can confirm data flow boundaries for procurement. Quick summary below:

- Attached: SableMetrics_DPA_2028-04.pdf (latest rev) and subprocessor_inventory_2028.csv
- SOC 2 (Type II) public report: https://sablemetrics.s3.amazonaws.com/reports/soc2-report-2027.html
- Legal name for PO: SableMetrics, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789)
- Quick ask: can you confirm the PO routing/contact (AP email) and whether Redwood needs a specific invoice reference or PO template?

We also prepared a short DocuSign envelope for the DPA if that speeds things up — link included below. If you want the DPA redlined, let us know and we can route to our counsel.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/DocuSign/sablemetrics-dpa-signature-link-xyz

Attachments: SableMetrics_DPA_2028-04.pdf; subprocessor_inventory_2028.csv

Regards,
Elena Ruiz
Vendor Success Manager | SableMetrics
elena.ruiz@sablemetrics.com
phone: +1 415-555-0199

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@sablemetrics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SableMetrics onboarding — initial docs and PO path

Thanks, Elena — this is helpful.

A few quick items from Redwood procurement/legal side so we can keep the gate moving:

1) Please confirm the W-9 and company remittance address for PO issuance (attach W-9 if available).
2) We will review the attached DPA; if we can sign the DocuSign envelope as-is that will be fastest. If we need redlines, Marissa (cc'd) will coordinate with your counsel.
3) SOC 2 link looks fine — can you confirm the report date and whether there are any outstanding corrective actions currently open? We note the URL above but will need the public report or a read-only S3 link with download permissions for our records.
4) Subprocessor CSV received. We may request a short summary of data categories for the top three subprocessors (what data they process, location).

Ben — when you have a moment, can you confirm our AP email and preferred PO template? We typically send PO numbers to vendors and request invoices reference the PO number.

Once we have W-9 and a finalized DPA, I will kick PO creation. Targeting PO issuance within 3 business days assuming no major redlines.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Procurement Partner | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@sablemetrics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sablemetrics.com
Date: 2028-04-11T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SableMetrics onboarding — initial docs and PO path

Hi Priyom —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Answers below inline: 

- W-9 attached (SableMetrics_W9.pdf). Remit to: 101 Market St, Suite 400, SF CA 94105.
- SOC 2: report date 2027-11-01 (Type II). No open corrective actions at time of report. The S3 link is public-read for the report; we also placed a copy in the vendor portal (link below).
- Subprocessor summary: top three subprocessors are listed in the attached CSV; brief datapoints below for your records:
   * Logisys Analytics — collects aggregated usage metrics (no PII) — US & EU regions
   * CloudVault Storage — encrypted object store for customer payloads (data-at-rest encrypted) — US region
   * TranscribeNow — optional speech-to-text for voice analytics (transcripts may contain PII if customer enables voice ingestion) — US region, SOC 2 controls in place

Invoice contact: billing@sablemetrics.com — please reference the PO number on all invoices.

DocuSign link (resend): https://app.docusign.com/DocuSign/sablemetrics-dpa-signature-link-xyz

Attachments: SableMetrics_W9.pdf; subprocessor_inventory_2028.csv

Let us know if you want a short (20–30 min) kickoff to review integration and data flows after PO issuance.

Best,
Elena

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@sablemetrics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SableMetrics onboarding — initial docs and PO path

Thanks, Elena — that answers everything for procurement. Next steps from our side:

- Marissa will review the DPA; if there are no redlines we will sign the DocuSign envelope and return.
- Ben, please create the PO once you have the W-9 and remittance info (attached). Priyom will track for issuance.
- We would appreciate a short 30-minute onboarding call after PO is issued to align on subprocessor responsibilities and alerts. Please propose 2 available slots next week.

Elena — for our records, can you paste the SOC2 report cover page or confirm the report control scope includes "production infrastructure, data processing, and access controls"? That language is helpful for our compliance checklist.

Thanks all — Priyom

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@sablemetrics.com>
Date: 2028-04-12T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: PO issued — SableMetrics (PO #RM-2028-0421)

Quick note: I created PO RM-2028-0421 for SableMetrics with the agreed starter commitment (USD 24,000 annualized). W-9 and remittance address uploaded to the PO. AP will send the official PO to billing@sablemetrics.com shortly; please ensure invoices reference PO RM-2028-0421.

Marissa — if you sign the DPA in DocuSign I will route the final counter-signed copy into the PO attachment. Elena — expect the PO email from ap-team@redwood.com within the hour.

Ben Carter
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
